description: This file contains the 'ReturnReason' class implementation for managing return reasons in the Opencart e-commerce platform, including CRUD operations and database interactions.

classes.name: ReturnReason
classes.description: A class extending the Opencart Model class, responsible for managing return reasons, including creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving return reason data from the database.

methods.name: addReturnReason
methods.description: Creates a new return reason record in the database, inserting data for multiple languages and returning the new return reason ID.

methods.name: editReturnReason
methods.description: Edits an existing return reason by first deleting it and then adding updated descriptions for each language.

methods.name: deleteReturnReason
methods.description: Deletes a return reason record from the database based on the primary key.

methods.name: deleteReturnReasonsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all return reasons associated with a specific language ID.

methods.name: getReturnReason
methods.description: Retrieves a specific return reason record based on its ID.

methods.name: getReturnReasons
methods.description: Retrieves a list of return reasons with optional filtering, sorting, pagination, and caching.

methods.name: getTotalReturnReasons
methods.description: Returns the total count of return reasons, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: addDescription
methods.description: Adds a description for a return reason in a specific language.

methods.name: deleteDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Deletes all descriptions for return reasons in a specified language.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Fetches a specific return reason description for a given return reason ID and language.

methods.name: getDescriptions
methods.description: Retrieves all descriptions for a specific return reason across languages.

methods.name: getDescriptionsByLanguageId
methods.description: Retrieves all return reason descriptions for a specific language ID.
